Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is headquartered in New York City based on the search results provided by the WebSurfer in the previous turn. The WebSurfer results clearly stated that TCS is headquartered in Mumbai, India (citing Wikipedia and Craft.co). The Planner hallucinated the location as New York City instead of correctly extracting the information from the available search results (Mumbai, India).
